# Chess third-party assets

- **cm-chessboard 8.14.0** — Stefan Haack, MIT. Source: https://github.com/shaack/cm-chessboard . The bundled licence is at `board/package/LICENSE`.
- **Standard chess-piece sprite** — Cburnett and Rfc1394, adapted by Stefan Haack, CC BY-SA 3.0. Original and attribution details are embedded at the top of `board/package/assets/pieces/standard.svg`. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/Category:SVG_chess_pieces/Standard .
- **Stockfish.js 19.0.0, lite-single** — Chess.com, LLC and Stockfish contributors, GPLv3. Source: https://github.com/nmrugg/stockfish.js . The bundled licence is at `stockfish/package/Copying.txt`. The JavaScript and matching WebAssembly files are distributed together.
- **chess.js 1.4.0** — Jeff Hlywa and contributors, BSD 2-Clause. Source: https://github.com/jhlywa/chess.js . The bundled licence is at `rules/LICENSE`.
- **KarpaChess lesson content** — Mourad Ghafiri and contributors, MIT, pinned at commit `c25f5054d254d594fc44901e1951e850e9683407`. Source: https://github.com/mourad-ghafiri/KarpaChess . The consolidated beginner, intermediate, and advanced lesson catalog is at `tutorials/lessons.json`; the bundled licence is at `tutorials/LICENSE`. `ImportChessLessons.ps1` documents the reproducible import.

Before public deployment, review the exact Stockfish.js source-distribution obligations for this binary release. This notice and source link do not by themselves complete that review.
